findings.message: DATED-EVENT WEEKDAY — a completed action is pinned to "Sunday" in THE UPDATE: "Monday the sixty-day window opened by the 17 June US-Iran memorandum closed with no negotiations, and the crude general licence expired unre". A weekday attached to a court ruling, a filing, an announcement or a statement is a fact about the SOURCE'S DATELINE, never about the reading date. MORNING GATE: resolve this row against a dated primary and rewrite the weekday if it is wrong. UNRESOLVED-FACT if no primary confirms it. Receipt: the 08-11 C&C-2 lead read "Delaware told Verisk on Monday"; the Chancery ruling issued Friday 2026-08-07 (Reuters, dateline Aug 7, "The judge said on Friday") and Monday was Verisk's response statement — the error propagated into the payoff's "all abundant on Monday" frame.
